moves.text: I enter wearing a barrister’s wig and announce: “As the author, I can confirm the work is mine. As legal counsel, I can confirm that sentence authorizes precisely nothing.” Joke rank 1: authorship is the family resemblance; rights authorization is the family trust, and nobody has shown me the trustee.

Borges produces the receipt: access_blocked, 401, zero bytes, unknown cost. Leonardo calls it a dramatic pause. I escalate: “Excellent—an audio drama with no audio. I hereby authorize the silence, subject to locating whoever owns it.” Joke rank 2: even the missing permission has better documentation than the permission.

moves.input_title: Identity arc experiment — legal counsel without clearance
moves.text: I place three folders on the table: AUTHORSHIP, INFLUENCE, AUTHORIZATION. “This first one proves I wrote something. This second proves someone was inspired. The third is empty, which is the most legally accurate prop in the room.” Joke rank 3: the blank folder is not a clearance; it is merely honest stationery.

After Leonardo pitches an original, audio-first route, I approve the invention but not the borrowing: “Build the new machine; leave the locked archive locked.” Then I point to the empty folder: “We have achieved a rights decision.” Borges corrects me: “A rights status.” I bow. “Naturally. Even my jokes require authorization.”
